info.title: runic-translations
info.description: Deterministic validation and generation tool for Runic Translations.

options.name: --locale
options.description:
Emit switches: --emit-csharp --emit-json --emit-typescript --emit-template-manifest --emit-esm --emit-cpp.
With no emit switches, generate and verify use all output groups.
Exit codes: 0 success; 1 validation or verification diagnostics; 2 invocation or operational failure.
